verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules, such as page-change monitoring with follow-up actions, are a plausible capability for a web-content API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only per-request options. `x-wait-for-selector` is a fetch-time wait condition, an adjacent control rather than a user-defined rule that triggers actions on events. Nothing documents event triggers, rule definitions, or automated actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
